table.retrieve:
select 
	V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Debit,
	credit= V.Credit,
	remark = V.Remarks,
	c.name,
	c.phone,
	c.address1,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=0,
	GRN = V.GRN,
	Vehicle = V.Vehicle,
	Agency = (SELECT GC.Name FROM GoodsCompany GC WHERE GC.GCCode = V.GCCode),
	ShipTo = V.ShipTo,
	Freight = CASE WHEN V.documenttype = 'SV' AND V.Debit > 0 THEN (SELECT S.FlatDisc FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = V.DocumentCode) ELSE 0 END
from     
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, ct.phone
	FROM	accounts a, 
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode)) CT, 
		area ar
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_custcode) and 
			a.acccode = ct.custcode and 
			ar.areacode=ct.areacode) C
where   (V.AccCode = C.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
union all
select	
	V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Credit,
	credit= V.Debit,
	remark = Case debit 
			When 0 then 'Cash Paid Against Sale Ret. # '
			Else 'Cash Received Against Sales Inv. # '
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))),
	c.name,
	c.phone,
	c.address1,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=0,
	GRN = V.GRN,
	Vehicle = V.Vehicle,
	Agency = (SELECT GC.Name FROM GoodsCompany GC WHERE GC.GCCode = V.GCCode),
	ShipTo = V.ShipTo,
	Freight = 0
from     VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, ct.phone
	FROM	accounts a, 
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode)) CT, 
		area ar
	WHERE a.acccode = ct.custcode and 	ar.areacode=ct.areacode) C
where   (V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	V.date     >= :ar_startdate and
	V.date     <= :ar_enddate
UNION ALL
select
	documentcode = N.NoteCode, 
	Type = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then '*NR' Else '*NP' End + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), N.NoteCode))),  
	date = N.duedate, 
	debit = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END END,
	credit= Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = C.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END END,
	remark = N.Remarks,
	c.name,
	c.phone,
	c.address1,
	cash = 'N',
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	CheckNo = LEFT(N.DocumentNumber, 20),
	VRow=999999,
	N.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=1,
	GRN = NULL,
	Vehicle = NULL,
	Agency = NULL,
	ShipTo = NULL,
	Freight = 0
from 
	Notes N,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, ct.phone
	FROM	accounts a, 
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode)) CT, 
		area ar
	WHERE a.acccode = ct.custcode and ar.areacode=ct.areacode) C
where   
	(N.AccCode = C.AccCode OR N.BankAccCode = C.AccCode ) and
	N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized = 'Y'
UNION ALL
select
	documentcode=NULL, 
	type = NULL, 
	date = :ar_enddate, 
	debit = 0,
	credit= 0,
	remark = 'OPENING BALANCE',
	c.name,
	c.phone,
	c.address1,
	cash = 'N',
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	openbalance=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=C.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate), 0),
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=0,
	vouchercode=NULL,
	PendingCheque=0,
	GRN = NULL,
	Vehicle = NULL,
	Agency = NULL,
	ShipTo = NULL,
	Freight = 0
from
   (SELECT a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1, ct.areacode, area=ar.name, ct.phone
	FROM	accounts a, 
		(SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
		UNION ALL
		SELECT CT.* 	FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode)) CT, 
		area ar
	WHERE a.acccode = ct.custcode and ar.areacode=ct.areacode AND 
			a.acccode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT VGL.AccCode 
			FROM VirtualGL VGL 
			WHERE VGL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND 
				VGL.AccCode IN 
					(SELECT CT.CustCode FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
					UNION ALL
					SELECT CT.CustCode FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode))
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.AccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN 
					(SELECT CT.CustCode FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
					UNION ALL
					SELECT CT.CustCode FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode))
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.BankAccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN 
					(SELECT CT.CustCode FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 1
					UNION ALL
					SELECT CT.CustCode FROM Customer CT WHERE :ai_allcustomers = 0 AND CT.CustCode IN (:ar_custcode)))) C
order by name, aliasname, date, type, VRow

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) > 0, 'Dr', IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) < 0, 'Cr', ''))

objects.name: c_runingbalance
objects.expression: abs( openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ))

objects.name: c_openbalance
objects.expression: abs(  openbalance  + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1) - debit + credit )

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) - debit + credit > 0, 'Dr', IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) - debit + credit < 0, 'Cr', ''))

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) > 0, 'Dr', IF(openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ) < 0, 'Cr', ''))

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: abs( openbalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for group 1 ))

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: 'SALES :' + TRIM(STRING(SUM( if(left(type,2)='SV', debit, 0) for group 1), '###,###,##0.00')) + ', S/R(CLAIM):' + TRIM(STRING(SUM( if(left(type,2)='SR',  credit , 0) for group 1), '###,###,##0.00'))
